schemas.method: Static text edits from recorded immutable Git blobs; no patcher/Prisma execution or schema output file.
schemas.source_attribution: Commit/tree/blob identities verified locally; not a signed build attestation or proof of final artifact content.

prisma.source_package_deploy_script: node runWithProvider.js "rm -rf ./prisma/migrations && cp -r ./prisma/DATABASE_PROVIDER-migrations ./prisma/migrations && npx prisma migrate deploy --schema ./prisma/DATABASE_PROVIDER-schema.prisma"
prisma.checksum_boundary: raw_sha256 hashes original Git blob bytes, not Windows checkout text. Neither it nor lf_text_sha256 is a deployed ledger checksum until final artifact bytes and ledger rows are captured.

operational_artifact.note: Reported reference/label/env are observations only. Baseline schema input equality cannot distinguish b206 from f248.
